applies_to: Eaton Power Xpert Meter 4000, 6000 and 8000 power quality meters on BACnet IP.
summary: The PXM 4000/6000/8000 meters serve one BACnet IP device with volts, currents, power, power factor, energy, demand, THD and frequency as Analog Inputs, min / max and peak time stamps as DateTime Values, and the last events as CharacterString Values. The three models share the same object list; a few objects need the auxiliary voltage card or a PXM 6000/8000.
notes: From IB150010EN table 1. The device object (printed as device:27005) is not repeated in the points list.

Objects that need the auxiliary voltage card: AI 210, AI 211, AI 212, AI 213, AI 379, AI 380, AI 381, AI 382, AI 399, AI 400, AI 401, AI 402, DTV 379, DTV 380, DTV 381, DTV 382, DTV 399, DTV 400, DTV 401, DTV 402.
Objects only on PXM 6000 and PXM 8000: PIV 521, PIV 522, PIV 523, PIV 524, PIV 525, PIV 526, PIV 527, PIV 528, PIV 590 (sag, swell and transient counters).
The booklet gives no units or access columns; all objects are listed as read-only.
Multistate state texts are as printed in the description column.

source.title: BACnet object list for Power Xpert Meter 4000/6000/8000

integration.summary: Discover the meter over BACnet IP and read total real power, energy, demand, power factor, average volts and currents, and frequency. Everything is read-only monitoring data.
setup: BACnet IP (Annex J); the meter can register as a foreign device for BACnet networks across subnets.
gotchas: Auxiliary-card voltage objects read only when that card is fitted.
Sag, swell and transient counters exist only on the PXM 6000 and 8000.
